[[File:Racebonds.jpg|thumb|Race bonds]]
Instead of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as a reward for winning [[Swoop racing/Legends|races]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Motta]] the Hutt gave racers '''race bonds'''. These digital certificates were accepted throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and could be sold for about sixty credits per note, with the exception [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], in which they can be sold for around one hundred and fifty. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] had won 120 bonds by the time he became the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sector champion.
